coordinate_frame: canonical meters, microphone at the origin, anchor = state[0] (x, y)
output: trapezoid integral of per-axis Viterbi bin centers from the supplied initial position

label_audit.temporal_pool: two stride-2 pools, then linear upsample to the audio frame
label_audit.corner_policy: Steps whose bins are illegal under the graded mask are dropped from framewise and CTC targets. CTC holds the last legal bin. The trajectory loss still follows the position label and does not require an illegal bin. A three-bin limit allows a 6 m/s jump per frame and does not make the path smooth.

decode_note: Viterbi matches the framewise argmax, so decoding is not flattening a different raw path.
